import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db, entity_ids, seed_time):
    # Извлекаем таблицы
    orders = db['orders'].copy()
    items = db['order_items'].copy()
    reviews = db['reviews'].copy()
    payments = db['payments'].copy()
    
    # Приводим seed_time к Timestamp
    if not isinstance(seed_time, pd.Timestamp):
        seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
        
    # Оставляем только заказы, сделанные до seed_time
    orders = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] <= seed_time]
    
    # Фильтруем items по времени: только те, что были куплены до seed_time
    items_filtered = items[items['ts'] <= seed_time]
    
    # Объединяем items с orders чтобы получить временные метки покупок
    df_items_with_time = items_filtered.merge(
        orders[['order_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp', 'order_delivered_customer_date', 'order_estimated_delivery_date']],
        on='order_id',
        how='inner'
    )
    
    # Вычисляем количество дней на доставку (только если известна дата доставки и она до seed_time)
    df_items_with_time['delivery_days'] = np.nan
    mask_delivered_before_seed = (
        df_items_with_time['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() &
        (df_items_with_time['order_delivered_customer_date'] <= seed_time)
    )
    df_items_with_time.loc[mask_delivered_before_seed, 'delivery_days'] = (
        df_items_with_time.loc[mask_delivered_before_seed, 'order_delivered_customer_date'] - 
        df_items_with_time.loc[mask_delivered_before_seed, 'order_purchase_timestamp']
    ).dt.days
    
    # Просрочка доставки (если известны обе даты и доставка была до seed_time)
    df_items_with_time['late'] = 0.0
    mask_late = (
        (df_items_with_time['order_delivered_customer_date'] > df_items_with_time['order_estimated_delivery_date']) &
        (df_items_with_time['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna()) &
        (df_items_with_time['order_estimated_delivery_date'].notna()) &
        (df_items_with_time['order_delivered_customer_date'] <= seed_time)
    )
    df_items_with_time.loc[mask_late, 'late'] = 1.0
    
    # Дни с момента покупки до seed_time
    df_items_with_time['days_since_purchase'] = (seed_time - df_items_with_time['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days
    
    # Индикаторы окон
    df_items_with_time['last_7'] = (df_items_with_time['days_since_purchase'] <= 7).astype(int)
    df_items_with_time['last_30'] = (df_items_with_time['days_since_purchase'] <= 30).astype(int)
    df_items_with_time['last_90'] = (df_items_with_time['days_since_purchase'] <= 90).astype(int)
    
    # Агрегация по product_id
    grouped = df_items_with_time.groupby('product_id').agg(
        num_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        num_items=('order_id', 'size'),
        total_price=('price', 'sum'),
        avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
        median_price=('price', 'median'),
        std_price=('price', 'std'),
        total_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
        avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
        avg_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'mean'),
        min_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'min'),
        max_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'max'),
        late_delivery_rate=('late', 'mean'),
        days_since_last_order=('days_since_purchase', 'min'),
        days_since_first_order=('days_since_purchase', 'max'),
        last_7_orders=('last_7', 'sum'),
        last_30_orders=('last_30', 'sum'),
        last_90_orders=('last_90', 'sum'),
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Частота заказов
    grouped['order_frequency'] = grouped['num_orders'] / (grouped['days_since_first_order'] + 1)
    
    # Отзывы: оставляем только те, которые созданы до seed_time
    reviews_filtered = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time]
    
    # Группируем отзывы по order_id
    review_agg = reviews_filtered.groupby('order_id').agg(
        avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
        num_reviews=('review_score', 'size')
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Присоединяем отзывы к данным о товарах
    df_with_reviews = df_items_with_time.merge(review_agg, on='order_id', how='left')
    
    # Убираем дубликаты по (product_id, order_id), чтобы учесть каждый заказ один раз
    unique_reviews_per_product = df_with_reviews[['product_id', 'order_id', 'avg_review_score']].drop_duplicates(subset=['product_id', 'order_id'])
    
    # Агрегируем отзывы по продукту
    review_prod = unique_reviews_per_product.groupby('product_id').agg(
        avg_review_score=('avg_review_score', 'mean'),
        num_reviews=('order_id', 'count')
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Платежи: оставляем только те, которые произошли до seed_time
    payments_filtered = payments[payments['ts'] <= seed_time]
    
    # Агрегируем платежи по order_id
    pay_agg = payments_filtered.groupby('order_id').agg(
        total_payment=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        num_payments=('payment_sequential', 'count')
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Присоединяем платежи к данным о товарах
    df_with_payments = df_items_with_time.merge(pay_agg, on='order_id', how='left')
    
    # Убираем дубликаты по (product_id, order_id)
    unique_payments_per_product = df_with_payments[['product_id', 'order_id', 'total_payment', 'num_payments']].drop_duplicates(subset=['product_id', 'order_id'])
    
    # Агрегируем платежи по продукту
    pay_prod = unique_payments_per_product.groupby('product_id').agg(
        avg_payment_value=('total_payment', 'mean'),
        avg_num_payments=('num_payments', 'mean'),
        total_payment_sum=('total_payment', 'sum')
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Объединяем все признаки
    features = grouped.merge(review_prod, on='product_id', how='left')
    features = features.merge(pay_prod, on='product_id', how='left')
    
    # Устанавливаем индекс
    features.set_index('product_id', inplace=True)
    
    # Реиндексируем по entity_ids и заполняем пропуски нулями
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    
    return features
